podcast.body: This was Wham!'s second US number one hit, featuring a notable saxophone line. The song is representative of the "Sophisti-pop" sound that emerged in the mid-80s, blending soul, cocktail jazz, and lavish production. "Think of the saxophone line on WAMS 2nd US number one, Carolus Whisper."

podcast.body: In America, this song was credited to Wham! featuring George Michael, though it was a George Michael solo single internationally. It features an iconic sax riff, indelible melody, and soulful vocal from George Michael, and crossed over to Billboard's R&B chart where it cracked the top 10. The song defeated Madonna's "Like a Virgin," Foreigner's "I Want to Know What Love Is," and another Wham! hit, "Wake Me Up Before You Go-Go," for the 1985 title. "Credit to WAM in America, but really a George Michael solo single around the world, careless whisper has only grown in stature since George Michael's untimely passing in 2016."
